leadText:
The Pokémon Theme Park (Japanese: ポケモン広場 Pokémon Plaza) is an -exclusive location in Kanto. It appeared in Pikachu's Vacation.

It is a large playground where s can leave their Pokémon. It has various forms of play-equipment, including a swing set, a climbing frame, a swimming pool and various other leisure activities for Pokémon to participate in. All of 's, 's, and 's Pokémon were let out to explore the area. Four notable wild Pokémon appear here, a , a , a and a .
